pages.title: Heat Is Shared
pages.text:
The **Blaze Burner** is the closest thing this pack has to a universal heater. Many mods read Create's heat, and Create reads heat from other mods.\
\
Basics: [#](2E5AAC)[Blaze Burner and Heat](entry://create_basics/heat)[#]().

**Cooking:** with Central Kitchen, a Blaze Burner heats a Farmer's Delight Cooking Pot or Skillet, and a Farmer's Delight Stove counts as a [#](7A3C9A)[passive heater](entry://glossary/passive_heater)[#]() under a Create [#](7A3C9A)[boiler](entry://glossary/boiler)[#]().\
\
See [#](2E5AAC)[Kitchen Automation](entry://food/kitchen_automation)[#]().
**Boilers:** besides the burner, Create's boiler accepts passive heat from the Stove, Twilight Forest's fiery storage blocks, lava, magma, campfires and fire. Weaker, but free.

**Your body:** with Create: Cold Sweat, lit burners, steam engines, fans and hot tanks warm nearby players. A factory doubles as a heater in winter or high up.\
\
See [#](2E5AAC)[Create and Altitude Heat](entry://survival/temperature_create)[#]().

**Flight:** burners lift [#](2E5AAC)[hot air balloons](entry://flight/balloons_and_lift)[#]() on Aeronautics ships, and they also keep the crew warm against altitude cold.\
\
**Power:** Create Propulsion's Stirling Engine turns heat below it into rotation.

**Water:** Thirst Was Reclaimed purifies water by boiling in a campfire or furnace. See [#](2E5AAC)[Thirst](entry://survival/thirst)[#]().\
\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** a fuelled burner is one of the biggest smog sources. Put a [#](2E5AAC)[Flue](entry://survival/pollution_control)[#]() on top. See [#](2E5AAC)[Pollution](entry://survival/pollution)[#]().
